title: Courier Move — Rooftop Vault to Archive Loft
motionDescription: Kuro Signal coils tightly on the concrete parapet, launches left-to-right across the moonlit canyon, vaults mid-air over neon alleys, streaks across utility wires in a cyan-magenta smear dash, brakes with a sparking heel-plant skid, absorbs impact in a deep squash crouch, and rebounds eagerly at the archive loft door.

reducedMotionAlternative.description: Hero mid-air parkour vault of Kuro Signal crossing the moonlit neon alley with portable receiver secured.

frames.actingNote: Tightly compressed sprinter coil at rooftop ledge; yellow lug boots poised, receiver tucked tight to chest.
Full diagonal extension pushing left-to-right off the concrete parapet; magenta hip strap whips behind.
Mid-air parkour tuck framed against the crescent moon above neon magenta-cyan alley walls.
High-impact punk-anime horizontal smear silhouette trailing vivid cyan and hot-magenta afterimages across rooftop cables.
Yellow lug-boot sole slams down onto the archive roof, kicking up graphic ink-dust clouds and electric impact sparks.
Deep shock-absorbing crouch outside the amber-lit archive studio doorway; warm doorway light rims Kuro's silhouette.
Springs upright outside the golden studio hatch, excited grin wide, glowing cyan receiver pulsing as fist rises to knock.
